scope: Primary-source shortlist, not an exhaustive inventory of all cybersecurity datasets

datasets.name: cAPTure
datasets.capture_note: Shifted semi-synthetic packet timelines; seven repeated scenario templates
datasets.status: two reduced CSVs acquired; consistency checks passed; no model fit
datasets.limits: Reduced-generation provenance and causal feature availability need further qualification

datasets.name: CAM-LDS
datasets.status: Acquisition and event proxy complete; five-family fixed-window diagnostic complete and audited; primary useful-signal gate failed
datasets.role: Exposed developmental manifestation-window proxy; primary pooled-window formulation retired
datasets.limits: Padded global weak labels, no ordinary benign-user workload; window diagnostic uses five exposed families and family4 has one target source interval; no exact malicious-event, early-warning or fresh-confirmation claim

datasets.name: Windows-APT2025
datasets.status: paper and public artifact route verified; file bytes not acquired
datasets.limits: 36 emulated scenarios; verify benign labels and scenario joins; named emulated profiles do not establish actor attribution

datasets.name: CICAPT-IIoT2024
datasets.status: paper/public page verified; current access requires contact form
datasets.limits: APT29-inspired emulation; actual bytes and independent-run structure not yet verified

datasets.name: DEDALE
datasets.limits: Four weeks, one APT exercise; whole raw collection about3.2TB, smaller log views available

datasets.name: CasinoLimit
datasets.status: Original robustness suite and structured-loss follow-up completed and audited; all three v2 primary gates failed
datasets.role: Completed recent second dataset for technique-versus-other-technique robustness
datasets.limits: 114 labeled instances of one challenge, some repeat players, no realistic ordinary-user benign background

datasets.name: Comprehensive Advanced Persistent Threats Dataset
datasets.status: 24-archive inventory and one small campaign file inspected
datasets.limits: Rule-derived labels and artificial stage markers in commands; independent benign truth unverified

datasets.name: AIT-LDSv2.1
datasets.status: Pilot, event robustness suite and structured-loss follow-up completed and audited; v2 primary gain below gate
datasets.limits: Selected intranet annotation pairs are attack-rich and dominated by directory scans; repeated templates; incomplete lifecycle coverage

datasets.name: AIT-ADS
datasets.status: 96MB archive acquired; exact alert-label joining pending
datasets.role: alternative alert view of AIT-LDS, not independent second data
datasets.limits: Attack-interval labels alone cannot identify individual malicious alerts

datasets.name: Linux-APT2024
datasets.limits: Suspicious labels are based on Wazuh TTP tags; measures rule imitation without independent incident labels

datasets.name: Corrected DARPA OpTC
datasets.limits: About939GB compressed; new corrections do not make the attack capture new

datasets.name: S-DAPT-2026
datasets.paper: January 10, 2026 arXiv preprint, withdrawn April 1; later SSRN preprint posted April 18
datasets.status: Registered candidate; evaluation plan prepared; corrected provenance/raw files not qualified; no model fit
datasets.role: Conditional synthetic alert-level stress and stage-progression supplement
datasets.limits: January paper and companion E-HiDNet paper withdrawn for analysis errors; later correction and peer-review status unverified. Potential direct stage/correlation/group-label shortcuts. No author-controlled dataset download located in checked sources.

datasets.name: SCVIC-APT-2021
datasets.license: CC-BY-4.0 according to official DataCite/DataPort record
datasets.status: Author training CSV qualified; 153919 feature-deduplicated rows and 73 predictors; development fitting performed
datasets.role: 32 labels per class stage comparison and separately scoped injected-label-noise experiment
datasets.limits: Only author training file available; exact feature deduplication does not establish incident independence; 15 InitialCompromise development-test rows; no temporal or early-warning claim

datasets.name: DAPT2020
datasets.license: Raw-file redistribution license not independently verified; retained privately
datasets.status: Ten local source CSVs audited; 86691 rows and only 15 exfiltration flows
datasets.role: Potential separately scoped diagnostic; not fitted in this batch
datasets.limits: Proposed all-stage few-shot grid unsupported; stage/day concentration prevents proposed complete-class temporal split

datasets.name: DSRL-APT-2023
datasets.status: Pinned 65000-row author CSV acquired and audited; no model fits in this batch
datasets.limits: CTGAN derivative of DAPT2020; not independent real-data validation; generated timestamps do not establish scenario sequences
